Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Adaptive Agentic Hybrid RAG with BPMN-Grounded Graph Reasoning for Explainable Enterprise Process Question Answering
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Canonical title immutably preserved across all manuscript and metadata files. Framework name ICICOS preserved as system designator.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Two-stage intent router classifies queries into workflow, gateway, document, or hybrid intents, achieving 74.9% strict accuracy on N=338 queries.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Exact 253/338 = 74.85% strict accuracy verified. Token reduction from 272,090 to 254,295 (6.54% token savings) confirmed against raw evaluation records.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: BPMN 2.0 attributed graph parsed into NetworkX directed graph for topological reachability and path extraction.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: NetworkX DiGraph traversal confirmed. Topological reachability formulation u ~> v => v !~> u for acyclic paths verified in Figure 2 and Figure 3.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Gateway branching conditions (conditionExpression) extracted from XML and serialized into text prompts for model-mediated reasoning.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Clarified in manuscript: conditions are parsed and prompt-serialized, not executed via a formal in-engine Boolean AST evaluation runtime.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Organizational swimlane participant roles extracted to bind tasks to actors; AAA on procedural subset is 0.625.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Exact numerical match confirmed across both cohorts. Swimlane role attribution limitation transparently disclosed in Section 6.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Dual-modal context fusion structures normative SOP text clauses alongside BPMN process execution traces in unified LLM prompt.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Prompt construction verified: fuses structural graph topology with normative document clauses before dispatch to generation.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Critic evaluates response across 5 explicit dimensions: factual grounding, domain compliance, workflow correctness, SOP correctness, completeness.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Preprint had vague 3-dim/4-dim text; revised manuscript strictly aligns with the 5-dimensional Pydantic schema in codebase.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Iterative self-repair loop bounded by N_max_repair = 2 refinement passes with structured diagnostic feedback.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Hard-bounded loop ceiling verified in code and unit tests. Prevents infinite loops and runaway compute under unrepairable outputs.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Automated metrics implement custom deterministic surrogate functions formulated in alignment with RAGAS principles, not official ragas package.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Manuscript rigorously discloses deterministic token-containment surrogate rather than unconstrained LLM-as-a-judge execution.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Semantic Alignment F1 (SA-F1) computes sentence-level greedy bipartite matching via SentenceTransformer MiniLM, not HuggingFace bert_score.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Metric renamed from BERTScore to SA-F1 in manuscript to prevent misinterpretation of underlying multilingual embedding pipeline.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Proposed ICICOS achieves 0.9883 Faithfulness (+0.1094 paired difference over Static Hybrid RAG, p_adj = 5.95e-10) and 0.0116 EUSR.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: 100% mathematically reproduced from raw observation records. GitHub README typo of 0.8585 definitively resolved as copy-paste draft error.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Paired Cohen's d_z for Faithfulness gain is d_z = 1.0809 (t = 9.043, p = 2.49e-13).
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Mathematical derivation d_z = mean_diff / s_D = 0.10938 / 0.10120 = 1.0809 verified. Legacy preprint claim of 1.34 corrected.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Answer Relevancy raw Wilcoxon p=0.0257 adjusts to p_adj=0.1030 under Holm-Bonferroni FWER control, denoting absence of evidence rather than equivalence.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Removed erroneous claims that relevancy was 'preserved within statistical margin'. Honestly reported as non-significant operational trade-off.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Context Recall achieves 1.0000 identically across all 70 pairs (s_D = 0), rendering paired t-test and Cohen's d_z mathematically undefined (N/A*).
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Replaced misleading 0.000 entry with explicit N/A* label and explanatory footnote detailing indeterminate 0/0 form.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Self-Refine Vector RAG achieves 0.8574 Faithfulness; Proposed ICICOS outperforms it by +0.1309 (p_adj = 1.56e-9, d_z = 0.8759).
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Proves that multi-pass compute without BPMN graph topology plateaus at ~0.857; graph retrieval is required for structural grounding.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Evaluated on open-weights Qwen-2.5-7B across 34 evaluation records on 7 unique queries due to cloud API rate limits.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Reframed from broad generalizability claim to architectural feasibility smoke test with full disclosure of sample size limitations.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Ablation study on N=20 queries demonstrates relative degradation when removing BPMN traversal (-12.8%) or Critic verification (-15.2%).
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Ablation trend verified on balanced 20-query diagnostic cohort. Relative contributions of graph and critic quantified.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Critic triggers self-repair on 17/70 queries (24.3%), increasing latency from 9.97s to 13.22s (+3.26s repair cost).
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Disentangled runtime repair rate (24.3%, 17/70) from offline calibration sweeps (27.1%, 19/70). Latency overhead documented transparently.

Claim_Statement_In_Manuscript: Nine explicit boundaries disclosed: author-curated benchmark (N=338), absence of external kappa, swimlane AAA gap (0.625), English/Indonesian bilingual scope.
Auditor_Findings_And_Caveats: Complete adherence to Elsevier KBS scientific reviewing guidelines. Eliminates exaggerated claims of universal generalization.
